# Pendulum Heroes (vendored)

`melon-pendulum.js` and `kinder-pendulum.js` are the owner's finished web components from the
"Pendulum Heroes" project (sources and build scripts live with that project, not here). They are
copied here unchanged and loaded on demand by `src/components/Footer/FooterPendulum.jsx`; the bar's
model is `src/assets/pendulum/kinder-bar.glb`. Don't edit these files: rebuild them in the source
project and copy them over again.
